heading: Pages

actions.openPage: Open page in a new tab

gsc.label: Google Search Console
gsc.description: Observed clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position from the selected rolling window.

dataforseo.label: Ranking snapshot
dataforseo.description: A point-in-time ranked-keyword snapshot. Clicks, impressions, and CTR are not available from this source.

demo.label: Demo ranking snapshot
demo.description: Sample ranking data for demos. It is not Google Search Console data or live ranking data.

none.label: No stored source
none.description: No Search Console page data or ranking snapshot has been saved yet.

states.backgroundLoading: Updating this view while keeping the previous data visible.

ready.title: Page data is ready
ready.gsc: Stored Search Console page data is ready.
ready.dataforseo: The saved ranking snapshot is ready.
ready.demo: The stored demo ranking snapshot is ready.

syncing.title: Search Console is syncing
syncing.gsc: The first Search Console page collection is still waiting or running. While Search Console is connected, this page shows only its data.
syncing.dataforseo: The ranking snapshot is being prepared.
syncing.demo: Demo ranking data is being prepared.
syncing.none: A stored source is being prepared.

empty.title: No matching pages
empty.gsc: Search Console returned no page rows for this selected rolling window.
empty.dataforseo: The ranking snapshot found no ranking pages for this market.
empty.demo: The demo snapshot contains no ranking pages for this context.
empty.none: No search data is stored for these pages yet. Get ranking data to collect it.

unavailable.title: Page data is unavailable
unavailable.gsc: Search Console data can't be read right now. Try again; this page won't switch to a ranking snapshot meanwhile.
unavailable.dataforseo: The ranking provider could not produce a stored snapshot. Retry when the provider is available.
unavailable.demo: Demo ranking data could not be loaded.
unavailable.none: No saved page data is available. Connect Google, or get ranking data.

stale.title: Showing the last good data
stale.gsc: Search Console freshness is uncertain or its latest refresh failed. The last successful rows remain visible.
stale.dataforseo: This ranking snapshot is out of date, or its latest refresh failed.
stale.demo: This demo snapshot is stale. The last successful rows remain visible.
stale.none: The last stored state is stale.

transport.title: Pages could not be loaded
transport.body: The request did not complete. Check the connection and try again.
transport.retained: The update failed, so the previous page data remains visible.

notFound.title: Site or page data was not found

refreshFailed.title: Refresh failed
refreshFailed.body: The last good data remains visible. Try the explicit refresh again when the source is available.

striking_distance.label: Striking distance
striking_distance.description: This page ranks close enough to improve and has meaningful search demand.

low_ctr.label: Low CTR
low_ctr.description: Observed impressions are strong, but the page earns fewer clicks than the rule threshold.

declining.label: Declining
declining.description: Position or observed clicks fell materially since the previous successful sync.

winning.label: Winning
winning.description: The page gained positions and sits on page one or earned clicks, or its observed clicks grew materially since the previous successful sync.

non_indexable_visibility.label: Visible but not crawl-indexable
non_indexable_visibility.description: The page has search performance while the latest RankMeFast crawl marks it non-indexable. This is not a Google index-status claim.

unmeasured.label: Unmeasured
unmeasured.description: The latest crawl found this indexable page, but the current performance source has no row for it.

low_data.label: Too little data
low_data.description: Search Console shows too few impressions and no clicks for this page, so it gets no movement label yet.

failure.redirect_loop: Its redirects loop back on themselves.
failure.redirect_limit: It redirects more than five times, so we stopped following.
failure.unsafe_redirect: It redirects to an address we do not follow.
failure.robots_blocked: robots.txt tells crawlers to skip this page.
failure.timeout: The page did not answer in time.
failure.non_html: This address serves {{type}}, not a web page.
failure.unreachable: We could not connect to this address.

evidence.fromProbe: Checked directly while the audit ran.
evidence.none: The audit did not record why this address is missing.
evidence.noCrawl: Run an audit to see how this address crawls.
evidence.botProtection: Some sites answer automated visits with this status. Check that the page opens in a normal browser window.

queries.anonymizedHelp: Google reported impressions for this page but did not share the search terms behind them. It hides rare queries to protect searchers' privacy, so zero here means no visible queries, not no searches.
queries.unavailableHelp: No search query data is stored for this page yet.

summaryNote.window: Per-page totals for {{start}} – {{end}}, for the pages that match your filters.
summaryNote.aggregation: Search Console counts an impression for each of your pages that appears in a result, including searches it keeps private, so these totals can be higher than the site totals on the Google tab. Average position is weighted by each page's impressions.

empty.fallback: The stored ranking snapshot contains no ranking pages for this market. Observed metrics remain unavailable.
empty.none: No page data has been saved yet. Connect Google, or get ranking data.
